create_regmatch_solver: create a Regret Matching solver with optimism and discount options for approximate Nash equilibrium computation
init_solver_variables: initialize solver parameters with number of strategies and players returning distribution and regret arrays
compute_regret_gradients: compute regret deltas and exploitability estimates from current distribution and payoff matrices
update_solver_params: update cumulative regret and strategy distribution using gradient-based regret matching with optional optimism
record_auxiliary_errors: record the norm of regret gradients as auxiliary error metrics during solver iterations
